extraction.text:
Bhalekar Siddharth

Email: siddharthbhalekar3@gmail.com |Mobile:7869776988 |Linkedin

 Professional Summary	

Product Manager with 8+ years of experience across Digital Banking, Retail & Core Banking, API Integrations, and Product Strategy. Led digital transformation and lending initiatives at SBI YONO and Canara ai1 Mobile Banking Applications, shaping seamless user experiences and scalable Banking Ecosystems. MBA in Digital Enterprise Management from IIM Udaipur with proven expertise in Product Visioning, Cross-functional Collaboration, and Data-driven Decision Making. Adept at bridging business and technology to deliver secure, compliant, and user-centric financial products using Agile and Design Thinking methodologies.

 Skills & Tools	

Product Management & Strategy-	(i)Product Roadmap Planning & Execution

(ii) Product Vision & Go-to-Market Strategy

(iii) Product Discovery & Requirement Prioritization

(iv) User Journey Mapping & Customer Experience Design

(v) Market Research & Competitive Benchmarking

(vi) Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Team Management

Tools -	(i) Jira

(ii) Confluence

(iii) Draw.io

(iv) Balsamiq

Conducted customer-centric research and gathered functional, regulatory, technical & business-critical requirements for SBI YONO.

Managed end-to-end project delivery within the Payments domain ensuring alignment with business objectives.

Facilitated discovery and prioritization workshops to validate use cases and define MVP enhancements within SBI YONO.

Implemented Digital Transformation strategies to automate workflows and improve operational efficiency.

Conducted competitive benchmarking of YONO against other banking applications to identify product enhancement opportunities.

Optimized SBI YONO’s digital lending roadmap to enhance user experience, ensure complaince and achieve key business outcomes.

Owned the lifecycle of digital lending features within SBI YONO — from discovery to delivery and continuous optimization.

Authored Product Requirement Documents translating business needs into clear functional specifications for development teams.

Collaborated with development and QA teams to successfully deliver seamless API integrations with SBI’s core banking system.

Reviewed detailed BRDs, process & data flow diagrams for SBI YONO lending modules including Education Loan, Personal Loan etc.

Partnered with UI/UX teams to design seamless digital loan journeys, significantly improving customer onboarding experience.

Owned end-to-end SIT/UAT testing cycles, ensuring timely, high-quality, defect-free, and seamless feature releases for SBI YONO.

Redesigned Personal loan journey by rebranding “RTXC” to “SBI Personal Loan” boosting loan conversion rate by 8%.

Shaped product strategy for innovative digital financial services by leveraging market insights to drive Financial Inclusion in India.

Developed strategic roadmap for the Business Correspondent model, expanding banking access in underserved rural communities.

Crafted and clearly articulated product vision for Canara ai1, aligning digital innovation with strategic customer-centric banking goals.

Defined and executed product roadmap and strategy for Canara ai1, aligning business goals with customer needs to drive adoption.

Led cross-functional teams to execute complex Payments integration projects across multiple platforms.

Benchmarked app performance against leading competitors from the BFSI Ecosystem, influencing strategic product decisions.

Conducted market research, customer journey mapping, & detailed gap analysis to design innovative, differentiated product features.

Credited for leading product discovery, requirement prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver impactful features.

Developed and established market positioning for Canara ai1, highlighting digital innovation and customer-focused differentiation.

Authored Product Requirement Documents for Canara ai1, translating business objectives into functional specificions.

Partnered with technology, design, and business teams to deliver user-centric enhancements across Digital Banking & Lending

Reviewed epics, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria to ensure smooth delivery of new functionalities for Canara ai1.

Facilitated key Agile ceremonies for the lending journeys to drive delivery excellence, team alignment, and transparency.

Owned and actively prioritized product backlog for lending journeys of Canara ai1, ensuring alignment with business goals.

Led end-to-end development of Canara ai1, achieving 50 lakh+ downloads, 40 lakh+ active users within 6 months of rollout.

Probationary Officer – Canara Bank	June 2014 – November 2015

Gained hands-on experience in Core Banking operations including Deposits, Savings, Lending & Risk Management at Canara Bank.

Handled Customer Onboarding, KYC Verification, Compliance Checks, while ensuring seamless operations & regulatory adherence.

Ensured adherence to audit requirements & regulatory standards of the branch, maintaining operational excellence & compliance.

Monitored NPAs and overdue accounts, supporting timely recovery actions and effective credit risk mitigation control stragegies.

Processed and authorised Retail Loan Applications ensuring complaince with internal credit policies of the bank and RBI guidelines.

Managed day to day branch operations including cash management, account servicing and customer grievance resolution.

Education Course Institute Year MBA-Digital Enterprise Management (Full Time) Indian Institute of Management Udaipur 2023-24 Bachelor of Engineering -Computer Science LNCT Indore, RGTU University Bhopal 2008-12

Academic Projects

Design Thinking - Digitalized & debiased innovative National Voting Mechanism using Empathy Maps and Iterative Prototyping

 Methodologies	

Agile & Scrum Practices

Waterfall model

Design Thinking

 Academic Projects	

Design Thinking - Digitalized & debiased innovative National Voting Mechanism using Empathy Maps and Iterative Prototyping

 Achievements	

Successfully cleared competitive exam IBPS PO from a pool of nearly 15 Lakhs candidates for approximately 9000 vacancies

 Certifications	

Certified in Agile methodology by Cognizant, applying Agile practices for efficient and collaborative Project Delivery process

Certified as an "International Software Testing Qualifications Board" (ISTQB) foundation-level certified software tester

 Extra Curriculars or Others	

Published an article on Blockchain, AI applications & Cloud Computing to transform rural banking and financial inclusion in India
